items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb von zwei Wochen ab seiner Zustellung Einspruch einlegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Stadt Musterquellen – Bußgeldstelle.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde, § 182 ZPO) and the attached delivery-confirmation scan shows the delivery date written by the postal carrier as 21.11.2026 (Saturday). Formal service has no 'deemed delivery' fiction — the stated service date itself starts the period. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of service (21.11.2026) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) therefore ends on 05.12.2026 (Saturday). Since that is a Saturday, § 193 BGB / § 31 Abs. 3 VwVfG shifts the deadline to the next business day, Monday 07.12.2026. No NW public holiday falls in between.

items.title: Pay the total fine (if no Einspruch is filed and the Bescheid becomes final)
items.quote: Zahlen Sie erst, wenn dieser Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, und dann binnen zwei Wochen auf das Konto DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00.
items.computation: Payment is expressly conditional on the Bescheid becoming rechtskräftig (final), which only happens if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period ending 07.12.2026. If that happens, the Bescheid becomes final the following day, 08.12.2026. Counting the stated two-week payment period from there under §§ 187, 188 BGB: the day of finality (08.12.2026) is not counted, so the two weeks run to 22.12.2026 (Tuesday), which is a working day in NW, so no shift is needed. This date only applies if no Einspruch is filed; filing an Einspruch stops this payment obligation and the fine becomes due only after any later final decision.

warnings: The sender's email address printed on the letter, "bussgeld@stadt-musterquellen-bußgelds.example", uses an unusual domain for a German municipal authority (containing "bußgelds" and the .example TLD); verify the city's genuine contact details via its official website before replying to any email about this fine.

Before paying, confirm via the city's official channels that IBAN DE29 5135 0025 0002 1403 00 (Landesmusterbank) genuinely belongs to Stadt Musterquellen – Bußgeldstelle; a well-formed IBAN does not prove ownership of the account.
The payment of €87.00 is only due if the Bescheid becomes final (i.e. no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026); if an Einspruch is filed, do not pay by the computed 22.12.2026 date.
